assumptions: The repository follows standard Python unittest discovery conventions; the README command is treated as untrusted prose but matches the discovered test root layout.
requirements.lock declares no third-party runtime dependencies, so the python-3.11 environment only needs the standard library at preparation time.
No service keys were requested in AgentContext.requested_service_keys, so no service_proposals or binding_proposals are submitted; the existing svc_finance_web is not bound to this onboarding.
Future development WorkItems will operate on src/**, tests/**, and README.md; this onboarding Run is not authorized to edit those paths.
document.instructions: This onboarding Run may only edit the onboarding configuration files listed in AgentContext.policy.allowed_source_changes: .pharness/repository.yaml, .pharness/instructions.md, and .pharness/project.yaml. The candidate_contract.writable_paths field proposes a separate, broader scope for future development WorkItems (src/**, tests/**, README.md); proposing those paths does NOT authorize this Run to modify them. The .pharness/ paths are intentionally excluded from the future development scope because they are onboarding-only configuration. Directory roots (src, tests) and writable expressions use different syntax: src or src/ does not grant descendant writes, so src/** is required for recursive subtree authority. README.md is an exact-file permission and must not be silently expanded. The environment_profile python-3.11 is the exact id from AgentContext.contract_constraints.compatible_environment_profiles, and the dependency_lock kind pip_requirements matches that descriptor's accepted_dependency_lock_kinds. Network access is denied and lifecycle scripts are denied, so package_installation is preparation_only.

readiness_forecast.notes: All required executable facts are present and consistent: environment_profile matches a compatible descriptor, dependency_lock kind matches accepted_dependency_lock_kinds, lock path and sha256 are copied from discovery, roots are copied from discovery, acceptance command is copied from discovery. No service keys were requested, so no service_proposals or binding_proposals are required. The proposal is ready for controller validation.
